paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的宁对出现组五条都选0，只表示在题述相关机会中未有这些反应；宁仍可能在清单未列的场合生过气，后十五条需独立回顾。乔也在前五条选0，且确认四周没有生气场合，后十五条明确选不计分。两份出现组都是合计0、均分0.00，但后续记录不应由第一组代填。第一组未覆盖全部生气原因，也不证明两人的生活或回应相同。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Ning chooses zero on all five occurrence prompts, reporting no such response on the specified relevant occasions. Ning may still have felt angry in an unlisted setting; the last fifteen prompts need separate reflection. Jo also selects five zeros but recalls no angry occasions in four weeks and explicitly leaves the last fifteen unscored. Both occurrence sums are zero with mean 0.00. The first part cannot fill their later choices: it covers neither every cause of anger nor their whole lives or responses.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样把题目覆盖的普通情境与人物全部经历分开，避免由一个零均分替后续作答？”可以只谈上述虚构人物，区分原回答、可观察行动与未知背景。允许不同意、拒答或结束，不需提供自己或他人的分数、私人对话、诊断或受伤经历；不要求对峙、坦白或同意某种情绪判断，也不把讨论作为安全评估。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can the listed ordinary situations stay separate from a person’s whole experience, without using a zero mean to answer later prompts?” Discuss only the fictional readers above, distinguishing responses, observable actions and unknown context. Participants may disagree, decline or end without personal or others’ scores, private conversations, diagnoses or experiences of harm. No confrontation, disclosure or agreement with an emotional judgment is required, and discussion serves no safety assessment.

paragraphs.zh: 本原创版本只供18岁及以上成年人回顾本人过去四周普通情境。二十条连续分四组各五条：前五条问题述日常情境发生时的怒意，后十五条问已经生气场合的外显、保留和选择感。前组没有覆盖全部怒意来源，零均分不自动代答后组；确无生气机会时，后十五条需逐条明确不计分，不填零。所有展示条目都须明确选择，空白尚未完成。0—4是从有相关机会时从未到几乎总如此的直接频率类别，2为有时，不是中立；无相关机会、不确定或不愿回答合并为一个不计分选项，无法辨认各自原因。每组五条均为数字才给合计0—20及合计除以5的均分0—4、显示两位小数；任一不计分则两个数字都不给，不显示残缺合计、不取其余均值、不补值，其他完整组保留。逐项回看与四份相同通用指南始终可读，包括全不计分完成时。没有跨组总分、排名、主导类型、风险等级、严重分段、常模、状态特质分类或专业STAXI换算；选择感不从怒意扣除，外显和保留也不互为反向。主题、四周范围、题目及完整组规则由编辑选定，未确立心理测量效度、语言等值、变化阈值或疗效。专业工具与一般支持来源仅供概念背景，不给新题授权、验证或背书。不评他人、关系安全、攻击危险、道德或求职适任；具体伤害也不能被小均分否定。无需诱发怒意、重开争执、联系别人、录音或披露私人事件。持续难以应对可按实际需要寻求合适支持，不等数字越线。答案与数字只留页面内存，无草稿或账户历史，按现有刷新、换语言、离开、历史恢复、清空或重测流程清除；复制仅含全部四篇公开指南标题与链接。常规页面分析关闭，可选匿名动作计数需本页许可与全站分析同意；清除不抹掉浏览器历史、截屏或旁人看屏。可只读、不讨论或退出，不用证明某种情绪人格。
paragraphs.en: This original edition is for adults aged 18 and over reflecting on their own ordinary situations in the past four weeks. Twenty consecutive prompts form four groups of five. The first five concern anger when specified everyday situations occurred; the last fifteen concern expression, privacy and perceived choice on occasions already feeling angry. The first part does not cover every source of anger. A zero mean does not fill later answers. With no angry occasions, explicitly leave each of the last fifteen unscored, not zero. Every displayed prompt requires a choice; blank is incomplete. Direct categories zero to four run from never to almost always on relevant occasions; two is sometimes, not neutral. No relevant occasion, uncertainty and declining share one unscored option that separates none of those reasons. All five numeric responses are needed for a part’s sum 0–20 and mean 0–4, the sum divided by five and displayed to two decimals. Any unscored response withholds both values, without a partial sum, mean of remaining responses or imputation. Other complete parts remain. Item readback and the same four general guides remain available, including completion with all unscored choices. There is no cross-part total, ranking, dominant type, risk tier, severity band, norm, state-trait classification or professional STAXI conversion. Perceived choice is not subtracted from anger, and expression and privacy are not reverse scores. Topics, four weeks, items and complete-part policy are editorial choices without established psychometric validity, language equivalence, change thresholds or treatment effects. Professional instruments and general support sources supply conceptual background, not permission, validation or endorsement of these new items. The record evaluates no other person, relationship safety, dangerousness, morality or job suitability; a low mean cannot dismiss actual harm. No anger induction, reopened argument, contact, recording or private event disclosure is required. Persistent difficulty can warrant appropriate support based on actual needs without crossing a numeric threshold. Answers and values stay in page memory without drafts or account history, following existing clearing on refresh, language change, leaving, history restoration, clearing or retaking. Copying includes all four public guide titles and links only. Ordinary page analytics is disabled; optional anonymous action counts require page permission and site analytics consent. Clearing erases no browser history, screenshots or screen observation. Reading alone, declining discussion or leaving requires no proof of an emotional identity.

paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Mu selects 4, 0, 2, 2, 2 on outward expression; Si selects 0, 4, 2, 2, 2. Both sums are ten and means 2.00, but one prompt concerns a sharper tone and another directly saying one is upset. The shared summary establishes neither equal communication effects nor anyone’s safety, dangerousness or need to hide feelings. Changing any one response to unscored withholds both values while retaining item readback; four remaining responses are not expanded into a complete sum.

Participants may disagree, decline or end without personal or others’ scores, private conversations, diagnoses or experiences of harm. paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Yu keeps a feeling private during an ordinary activity and wants to decide later whether to discuss it. An looks equally composed but feels unable to speak freely. Even if both select five twos on keeping feelings private, giving ten and 2.00, frequencies establish neither reasons, actual options nor relationship safety. An need not disclose to lower a score; Yu is not established to be suppressing feelings or heading toward an outburst. Discussion can retain unknown reasons without reopening an exchange or answering for either reader.

Participants may disagree, decline or end without personal or others’ scores, private conversations, diagnoses or experiences of harm. paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Yue feels able to wait before replying to a nonessential message, but the page knows neither whether Yue waited nor whether the reply was appropriate. Cheng faces a safety procedure requiring timely action and may lack the options described. Five fours would give Yue twenty and 4.00, not a perfect ability-test result or safety guarantee. If the relevant situations do not apply to Cheng, unscored retains that limitation rather than assigning zero ability. Pausing, expression and privacy depend on actual circumstances; no necessary procedure changes to produce a better number.
